### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/yuan2go/importer-pc/blob/2116c3b90b6fe7c729d0888452b6a1ca4d3bd7f5/src/Ipc.Platform/ExtensionStore.cs#L75-L76 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Keep ID/version bindings immutable after uninstall** When package H1 has been uninstalled, its retained registration has status `Uninstalled`, so this filter ignores it and accepts a differently signed H2 with the same package ID and version. That allows one displayed version to refer to different bytes across audit and deployment history; check all retained registrations, while still allowing the exact prior reference to be reinstalled. --- https://github.com/yuan2go/importer-pc/blob/2116c3b90b6fe7c729d0888452b6a1ca4d3bd7f5/src/Ipc.Platform/ExtensionPackages.cs#L126-L130 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Validate managed dependency references during inspection** For a signed DLL with a static assembly reference absent from both its signed `Files` and declared package dependencies, `Inspect` still returns a verified package because this validation only checks P/Invoke methods and declared entry types. The package can consequently be registered as installed and fail only when the ALC/JIT first resolves that reference, potentially during activation or first use; validate each managed assembly reference against the host/framework allowlist and exact signed dependency closure before accepting the package.
